name: ema61_breakout/monthly_candle_stop_nifty200_tighten
description: Monthly candle opens below and closes above EMA61; buy above its high next month; stop at its low. No new entries while NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average (Sensex before mid-2008). While NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average, open trades' stops are raised to the last completed week's low.
